shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. There is one empty place. A man in a purple shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat and claims that ordinary baseline skills define accomplishment, a woman in a green shirt sits at the pinboard-side aisle seat, and a woman in an orange shirt sits at the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the pinboard in frame.

shots.content: A man in a red shirt enters and sits in the empty place. He counters that genuine accomplishment demands a rigorous standard of mastery, and a man in a purple shirt asks what that standard requires.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt observes that such a threshold explains why mastery is rare, and a man in a purple shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the worktable.
